asr.full_text: Hey guys Moshe the Electric Israelis here thank you for joining give me a thumbs up please subscribe to my channel thank you to all my supporters. JP Morgan analyst Mark Delaney just upgraded a Tesla stock price to $864 Tesla stock is trading right now I'm looking at it as I speak it's up by $12 to $722 in today's trading. And Tesla stock has been up 70% year to date and 24% this week. So if you look at the global market of car sales, it's down 30% in the month of March. And it's going to be horrible in the month of April because of the pandemic. So why is Mark Delaney giving it a boost in the stock price and recommending to buy? Because he said that global sales of EVs will go to 15% by 2030 from 2% right now, 15 million car per year. Now, if you look at Tesla's share, market share as of now, it is over 60% in the United States. About 17% around the world. In China, in China, in the month of March,. Tesla is now responsible for 30% of the China sales. In the month of March. It sold close to 13,000 Tesla Model S, S, X, and 3. Obviously, 3 have the most share. It's incredible. So he said because the EV market will grow exponentially. Exponentially year over year over year and EV is where the car industry is going to go to. And seeing the Tesla market share right now and how it's going to be growing that will give you. The boost to the stock price and the stock is responding tremendously now also it's important. To say that because of this global pandemic that is going to last for the next year year and a half. Until there is a vaccine. That we know. Life is not going to be normal for a while. I would say for years, for years to come. It's going to be different normal. And maybe the old normal was not so good to begin with. So the new normal maybe will be much better. Than the old normal. But that's another topic. Tesla is investing only in electric cars. All the other manufacturers,. All of them are not going to,. They are putting things on hold. Because of the global pandemic. So when we come out of the other side,. It's going to be very, very slow, very, very slow. Until we'll get to whatever new normal that is. EV sales will continue. And there is really one manufacturer,. One company that does only that. And that is Tesla. And that's why the prediction of not only the exponential growth in EV sales,. But the exponential growth in market share. For Tesla cars. So this year is going to be rough. There is no question about it for everybody,. Including Tesla sales. I don't know if they're going to hit. Their target of over half a million this year. But look down the road,. Always look down the road. They're going to continue. To exponentially grow their share. And EV share of the global market. Is continuing to grow. That is point. That's Mark Dennis' point. And I completely and totally agree with him totally agree with him and that's why you see. The surge of the Tesla stock this week and moving on to go so if you sold a Tesla stock you got. Panicked and you sold it a month or two months ago you better buy it now or else I'm not recommending. I don't recommend anything but if I give you one advice that I do this is what I do I'm not telling. You do but it's my what i do is i just don't sell i hold i hold and when i have a chance i buy more. Thank you guys for watching do what you think it's right for you i'll see you tomorrow.
